pkg.title: Layer 07: consolidate the durable-agent labs to one primer, one core and one lab
pkg.scope: 07-application-agent-framework/long-running-durable/** (everything under it); 07-application-agent-framework/README.md (the long-running-durable row, its 'Run it' line, the caveats that name these labs, and the Colab section via the generator); CURRICULUM.md (module 07.2, the drills and hour lines that name these labs); COMPUTE.md (rows that name these labs); tools/ci/labs.json (the durable labs' entries); the generated Colab sections of layer READMEs and COLAB.md (only via `python3 tools/gen_colab_index.py`) and mkdocs.yml (only via `python3 tools/site/build_site_content.py`).
pkg.findings:
DECISION (approved): the durable-agent topic keeps ONE lineage — `lra-core` (the core) and `lra-gcp` (the lab) — and folds the unique material of the other two lineages into it. The review's map of what is duplicate and what is unique is tools/orchestration/reviews/2026-09-26-adversarial-review.md §7, first bullet (read it first; the byte-identical duplicates were already removed by the fix plan).

C1 LAYOUT. After your change `07-application-agent-framework/long-running-durable/` contains exactly: `README.md` (the topic index, README-STYLE shape), `PRIMER.md` (today `00_primer.md`, renamed with `git mv`; content kept), `lra-core/` (today `lra-core/lra-core/`) and `lra-gcp/` (today `lra/lra-gcp/`). The wrapper directories `lra/`, the outer `lra-core/`, `long-running-agentic/` and the labs `long-running-agents-core/`, `long-running-agents-gcp/` (inside long-running-agentic/), `long-running-agents-mistral/` no longer exist. Every move is a `git mv`.

C2 NOTHING UNIQUE IS LOST. Before deleting a lab, diff it against what is kept and carry over: (a) the drills B1–B8 (`02_design_drills.md` or wherever they live in long-running-agents-gcp) into `PRIMER.md`'s design-review section or a `DRILLS.md` beside it, and the §5 limits table and §7 estimates of long-running-agents-gcp's docs if PRIMER.md lacks them; (b) `adk/nightly_workflow.py` and the `04_adk_workflow` notebook pair as an optional ADK example inside `lra-gcp` (its own `adk` extra, off by default: the default install and the offline tests must not need ADK or the Google Cloud clients — that install is ~220 MB); (c) the Mistral material of long-running-agents-mistral — `mistral_workflow.py`, `mistral_model.py`, `local_temporal.py`, its two notebooks and its tests — as an optional `mistral` provider path of `lra-gcp` (a `mistral` extra; if the Mistral workflows library needs Python 3.12+, guard with `pytest.importorskip`/version skips so the suite passes on 3.11 and runs fully on 3.12); (d) any exercise or check in the removed labs' notebooks that the kept notebooks do not already teach, as new exercises (blank + solution) in the kept notebooks; (e) the demo scripts if they show something the kept examples do not. List in the PR body every carried item and every item deliberately dropped with the reason (byte-identical, superseded by a stronger lra equivalent).

C3 STANDARD NOTEBOOK LAYOUT for the kept core and lab: blanks in `notebooks/NN_name.ipynb`, worked answers in `solutions/NN_name.ipynb` with the SAME file name (lra-core today uses `notebooks/solutions/`; lra-gcp today uses `notebooks/practice/` + `notebooks/worked/`). Update `lra-gcp/scripts/build_notebooks.py` (and lra-core's tooling if any) to emit that layout; keep the Colab bootstrap cell (the builder imports the injector's `make_cell`) and stable cell ids; rebuilding on a clean tree is a no-op; every blank stops at its first exercise with `NotImplementedError` and every solution runs clean under the lab's `run_notebooks.py` (or the repo's `--expect-fail` convention).

C4 TESTS. The kept labs' tests pass in a fresh venv installed as their READMEs say; carried-over Mistral and ADK tests are kept and skip cleanly when the optional extra is absent; test counts before and after are re-measured and stated in the READMEs and the PR body.

C5 NO STALE REFERENCES. Update the 07 layer README (row, run-it line, caveats), CURRICULUM.md (07.2 and drills), COMPUTE.md, tools/ci/labs.json (drop the deleted labs' entries, fix moved paths and solutions steps; keep a Python 3.12 entry for the Mistral extra if it needs 3.12), the primer's and READMEs' internal links; regenerate mkdocs.yml and the Colab index. `python3 tools/orchestration/mdlinks.py` is clean on every changed .md. This grep over tracked files finds nothing outside CLAUDE.md and tools/orchestration/reviews/ (which you must not edit): `git grep -n -E 'long-running-agents-(core|gcp|mistral)|long-running-agentic|lra/lra-gcp|lra-core/lra-core|00_primer\.md'`.

C6 READMES. The topic, core and lab READMEs follow tools/orchestration/README-STYLE.md; the topic README says in one sentence which lineages were folded in and what came from each.

C7 CI. `tools/ci/run_local.sh --check`, `tools/ci/run_local.sh lra-core`, `tools/ci/run_local.sh lra-gcp` (and any 3.12 entry you keep, if a 3.12 interpreter exists here — otherwise state that it was not run), `--notebooks`, `--colab-index` and `--docs` all pass on your committed tree.
pkg.verify: In your own fresh venv, from the worktree root: (a) for each kept lab in scope, install it exactly as its README says and run `python3 -m pytest -q` in it; (b) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --check` (lab list complete, CI helpers tested); (c) `tools/ci/run_local.sh <lab-id>` for every lab id in scope that remains in tools/ci/labs.json; (d) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --notebooks` (every builder and the injector are no-ops on your committed tree); (e) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --colab-index`; (f) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --docs` (site generator tests, mkdocs.yml regenerated unchanged, strict mkdocs build, link check over all tracked Markdown) — read the usage comment at the top of tools/ci/run_local.sh first; (g) `python3 tools/orchestration/mdlinks.py <every .md you changed>`; (h) the stale-path grep named in the criteria; (i) `git status --porcelain` is empty after rebuilding notebooks and regenerating. Paste the tail of each result.
pkg.notes: Python here is 3.11 (check `python3.12` availability with `which`). The old long-running-agents-gcp tests need ADK 2 and Google Cloud clients (~220 MB, offline): install them in your venv only if you need to run a carried-over ADK test; never make them a default dependency of lra-gcp. Never install torch. Do not run `ipykernel install --user` (use `python3 -m ipykernel` from your venv only if a notebook run needs a kernel; the labs' run_notebooks tooling already handles this). The identity of notebooks matters for the Colab links: after the move, run `python3 tools/gen_colab_index.py` and commit what it regenerates. Do not change the notebook layout of any lab outside this topic (package c3 does that). Keep the 07 README's Colab section regenerated, not hand-edited.
pkg.allow_exceptions: tools/ci/ci.py only if a hardcoded lab name or path blocks criterion C7 (say so in the PR body); the root README.md only on lines that link to a path you move or remove.
